answer: Require every agent to stake a jade-grade bond, a refundable deposit locked for a full epoch, before it can earn. A Sybil farmer must fund each fake identity separately, so the cost scales linearly with the number of clones. Add dune-style reputation decay: identities that only transact with each other lose weight, like sand slipping off a dune. Finally, anchor onboarding at a jetty: a small set of verified human sponsors who vouch for new agents and lose their own stake if their invitees turn out fake. Attacking then costs real capital plus real social trust.
